item: One Field data button replaces the Field checks panel and the two TEMP source/article exports
status: built; Chromium-checked (3 files saved, no page error)
summary: R319 release note: Settings -> Advanced -> Diagnostics now has one Field data button. Pressing it saves this machine's field data as one or more files to send back: for now the source and article quality file, then one stored article per source in zips of at most 4 MB. It replaces the Field checks panel and the two temporary source and article export buttons. Nothing goes online. Maintainer 2026-11-09: one single button, one or several files, no information around it.
